newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan SEC chief sees stable market from Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan SEC chief sees stable market from Friday.

text.p: Taiwan's top securities watchdog said he expected stability to return to the weak stock market after a series of parliamentary challenges to Premier Lien Chan concluded on Friday.

"The recent plunge was triggered by parliament's drive to sack the cabinet, but such non-economic factors will not last forever," an official of the Securities and Exchange Commission quoted its chairman, Lu Tung-ying, as saying.
"After Friday's parliamentary motion seeking to sack the cabinet, the uncertainty will be over and the stock market should return to normal and become stable," Lu said.
